description.narrative: Byarna Palanca och Tudora ligger vid gränsövergången till Ukraina och det är där tillfälliga flyktingläger finns. Betydande mängder humanitärt bistånd har getts till flyktingar i dessa två ganska små byar. Projektet syftar till att stödja LPA: s ansträngningar från de två byarna för att hantera de ytterligare avfallsvolymerna till följd av humanitärt bistånd. Projektet kommer att implementeras av Public Association EcoContact.

Palanca and Tudora villages are situated at the border crossing with Ukraine and it is where temporary refugee camps are situated. Considerable amount of humanitarian aid has been provided for refugees in these two rather small villages. The project aims to support the efforts of the LPA from the two villages to manage the additional volumes of waste resulting from humanitarian assistance. The implementing partner is Public Association EcoContact.

The objective of the intervention is to address the waste management issues in Palanca village at the border with Ukraine.
Due to the influx of refugees and humanitarian support granted without considering environmental aspects, the local public administration is struggling with bigger amounts of plastic waste that ends up in an unauthorized landfill.
The project will support the LPA with a plastic waste press and other measures to address this problem.
